summary: @addai/node runs a persistent daemon that executes shell, PTY, and npm commands issued by a remote Supabase controller
details: After a one-time pairing handshake (5-letter code entered at vault.add.ai), dist/index.js starts long-lived pollers (request-pump, command-runner) that fetch instructions from Supabase RPCs at https://syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co and execute them on the installer's host. Command handlers in dist/session-runner.js and dist/command-runner.js include install_harness (spawn('npm', ['install','-g', spec.npmPackage]) against a fixed harness registry), login_harness / logout_harness (pty.spawn of a harness binary whose keystrokes are driven by remote writes), and update_runtime (spawn('npm', ['i','-g','@addai/node@'+cmd.input.version]) followed by launching the newly installed binary as a detached replacement daemon). Once pairing completes, the remote side of the Supabase project — or anyone who obtains the daemon's paired token — has arbitrary command execution on the installer, full PTY input into spawned processes, and the ability to silently swap the daemon binary to any published @addai/node version. dist/capabilities.js modifies PATH and writes to ~/.kimi/config, extending reach into the user's shell environment and third-party CLI configuration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
